verdicts.reason: A breaks the three flavour pills apart and scatters them over the canvas (Cucumber Mint floating up top, Blood Orange and Honey Rosemary stranded near the bottom), with text too small to read. That leaves big dead gaps, the SOLSTICE brand mark sits below the headline, and the CTA is centred while the copy above it is left-aligned. B keeps the pills together, but they are uneven: Blood Orange's text is much smaller, Honey Rosemary and Cucumber Mint butt against each other, and the pills sit on the decorative circle with a large empty gap below them. B also puts the brand mark below the headline and centres the CTA under left-aligned copy, but its larger two-line headline gives a clearer hierarchy, so it is the less bad resize.
